thread:
jamal: quick follow-up from the EU failover dry-run today — want to capture concrete remediation owners and next steps. Key observations: routing policy flip under spike, snapshot restores slower and a few checksum mismatches, runbook ambiguous for partial-region restore ordering.

maria: noted. added initial notes to TSK-7893. can we assign owners + ETAs?

chris: i'll take the multi-region routing audit (verify route weights, probe windows, fallback priorities). adding details to TSK-7893. ETA: Fri EOD. :white_check_mark:

jamal: chris please log exact divergences between intended routing policy and what the edge config shows — include remediation commands and safe rollback steps.

chris: sample commands i'll run:
```
gcloud compute url-maps describe redwood-ingress --region=europe-west1
kubectl -n infra get svc router-probe -o yaml
```

sara: i'll own snapshot/restore perf and the checksum mismatch investigation. creating TSK-7901. plan: run restores with dedicated I/O window and capture timeline + error samples. ETA: Mon 18:00 UTC.

maria: i'll update the runbook. current ambiguity: step 4.2 vs 4.3 around token flush vs partial restore. i'll add a decision tree and explicit pre-restore checklist. creating TSK-7894. ETA: Tue 10:00 UTC.

ops-bot: deploybot: Deployment 2026-03-19T14:02 UTC to infra/backup-scheduler started by @sara — logs: https://ci.redwood/dep/4421 :truck:

jamal: summarizing action items for weekly DR cadence doc:
- TSK-7893: routing config audit -> owner: chris -> due: Fri EOD
- TSK-7901: restore perf + checksum analysis -> owner: sara -> due: Mon 18:00 UTC
- TSK-7894: runbook edits + decision tree -> owner: maria -> due: Tue 10:00 UTC
- INC-4321: recurring routing-spike pattern -> owners: eng-runtime + eng-sre -> needs hypothesis sync

chris: for INC-4321 i'll add a telemetry query and dashboard tile: cross-region p95 latency vs route-weight shifts. will coordinate with eng-runtime for KV-cache metrics.

maria: propose a 30m game-day rehearsal next week to validate fixes: controlled traffic spike, snapshot restore, and route failover sim. suggest Wed 15:00 UTC.

jamal: Wed 15:00 UTC works. sara/chris/maria please create invites and include pre-req checklist. i'll be incident lead. ops-bot mark as DR rehearsal.

ops-bot: calendarbot: Event created: "DR rehearsal — routing & restore practice" Wed 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC. Invitees: jamal, maria, chris, sara, eng-runtime, eng-sre. Reminder 30m prior.

sara: note from today: ~12% of restores hit checksum mismatch on partial shard replays. i'll attach logs and mitigation (retry with shard-verify, backoff) in TSK-7901.

jamal: please update the tickets with short test plans before EOD tomorrow. i'll consolidate for leadership. thanks all. :thumbsup:
